BiblicalUsage: Pelilah is justice, judgment executed. Isaiah tells Moab to take counsel and execute judgment, to hide the outcasts and not betray the wanderer.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that justice is not an idea but an act: take counsel, then do it — and hide the outcast while you do.
